description: List inventory entries (what is on hand, where). Optional: location_id, food_id, include_empty (entries with amount 0 or less are hidden unless true), page, page_size.

food_id.description: Only entries for this food ID, from list_foods.

format.description: slim (default) returns a compact shape. full returns the raw Tandoor object.

include_empty.description: Include entries with amount 0 or less. Default false.

location_id.description: Only entries at this location ID, from list_inventory_locations.

name: list_inventory_entries
title: List inventory entries
